note: Salesforce Pull imports Salesforce records into Drupal, driven by each salesforce_mapping's pull sync-triggers (pull_create/pull_update/pull_delete) and per-mapping scope (pull_where_clause, pull_trigger_date, pull_record_type_filter), through a QueueHandler + cron queue workers, capped by salesforce.settings.pull_max_queue_size. Querying needs a Salesforce connection, so all medium/hard cases are grounded in LOCAL config (mapping pull triggers, pull_max_queue_size), created/read/modified with no connection and verified by pure reads. Namespaced sfl_* mappings removed on cleanup; pull_max_queue_size restored to 100000.

evals.prompt: How does Salesforce Pull decide which Salesforce changes to import into Drupal - what controls create/update/delete on the Drupal side?
evals.expected_output: It is driven by the salesforce_mapping's sync_triggers: pull_create, pull_update and pull_delete. For each mapping with a matching pull trigger, changed Salesforce records are queried and the corresponding Drupal entities created/updated/deleted.

evals.prompt: How can I limit which Salesforce records Salesforce Pull imports for a given mapping (e.g. an extra filter or a date field)?
evals.expected_output: Per mapping: pull_where_clause adds an extra SOQL filter, pull_trigger_date sets the Salesforce date field used to detect changes, and pull_record_type_filter restricts by record type.

evals.prompt: How is the Salesforce pull queue processed, and which setting caps how many items can be enqueued at once?
evals.expected_output: A QueueHandler builds the pull queue (capped by salesforce.settings.pull_max_queue_size) and cron queue workers (CronPull / SalesforcePullQueueWorker) process it on cron; with standalone enabled it can be triggered via the pull endpoints.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Salesforce mapping sfl_med. Inspect its live configuration and say whether it imports newly-created Salesforce records into Drupal.
evals.expected_output: Yes: sfl_med has sync_triggers.pull_create = true, so new Salesforce records are pulled in and created in Drupal.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, what is the maximum Salesforce pull queue size configured? Inspect the live Salesforce settings and give the number.
evals.expected_output: The pull queue max size is 750: salesforce.settings pull_max_queue_size = 750.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Salesforce mapping sfl_task that imports new Salesforce records but not updates. Configure it so that updates to the Salesforce record are also pulled into Drupal (enable the pull-on-update trigger). Apply the change to the live site.
On this Drupal site, limit the Salesforce pull queue so that at most 1000 items can be enqueued for pull at any time. Apply the change to the live site.
